mode.Name: Automatic fitting
mode.Hint: What to do when a token is created or its image changes. Auto: apply immediately when detection is confident enough. Ask: show a prompt with Apply / Adjust buttons. Off: only fit when you press the button.

confidenceThreshold.Name: Confidence threshold
confidenceThreshold.Hint: Detections below this confidence are never applied silently; you get the manual alignment window instead.

referenceEdge.Name: Border line to align
referenceEdge.Hint: Which line of the painted border should sit on the token's grid shape: its outer edge, the middle of the band, or its inner edge.

aspectMode.Name: Proportions
aspectMode.Hint: Stretch: match the token shape's bounding box exactly (width and height separately). Keep: scale uniformly so the border fits inside the box. Auto: stretch only when the difference is small (up to 8 %), otherwise keep proportions — useful for size 2+ hex tokens whose box is not hex-shaped.

ringBehavior.Name: Dynamic Token Ring
ringBehavior.Hint: Tokens using Foundry's dynamic ring frame the art themselves. Skip leaves them alone (with a warning); Apply fits them anyway.

pf2eAutoscale.Name: PF2e: turn off token autoscale when fitting
pf2eAutoscale.Hint: Pathfinder 2e overwrites token scale for small creatures while autoscale is on. Fitting a token turns autoscale off for that token so the fit stays.

prototypeTokens.Name: Fit prototype tokens
prototypeTokens.Hint: Also detect and fit when an actor's prototype token image changes. Tokens created from a fitted prototype are re-fitted for the scene they are placed on.

tryOtherShapes.Name: Try other border shapes
tryOtherShapes.Hint: If the shape expected from the grid isn't found, also look for circles, squares and the other hex orientation.

rotationTolerance.Name: Rotation tolerance (degrees)
rotationTolerance.Hint: How far a painted border may be rotated from the grid orientation and still be detected.

gridlessShape.Name: Expected border on gridless scenes
gridlessShape.Hint: Border shape to look for first on gridless scenes (tokens with a rectangle shape always look for a square).

squareGridShape.Name: Expected border on square grids
squareGridShape.Hint: Auto: circle for tokens with an ellipse shape, square otherwise.

debugOverlay.Name: Debug overlay
debugOverlay.Hint: Draw the target box (cyan), the predicted border (magenta) and the rendered border (green) on fitted tokens.

hudButton.Name: Token HUD button
hudButton.Hint: Add a button to the token HUD: click to fit, right-click to align manually.

useCache.Name: Cache detections
useCache.Hint: Remember detection results per image in this browser so the same image is fitted instantly next time.

maxDetectSize.Name: Detection resolution (px)
maxDetectSize.Hint: Larger images are scaled down to this size on the longest side before detection. Higher is slower but can help with very thin borders.

notifications.Name: Notify when a fit is applied
notifications.Hint: Show a notification each time a token is fitted automatically.

clearCache.Name: Detection cache
clearCache.Label: Clear cache
clearCache.Hint: Forget all cached detection results in this browser.
